canonical.name: The complement condition must be taken in the Riemann sphere, not in C
The winding number gives the circle degree and hence the fundamental group of the punctured plane
From this page onward, simply connected for plane domains is the unqualified grand-equivalent notion
For plane domains, trivial fundamental group forces homological simple connectivity
For plane domains, homological simple connectivity forces connected spherical complement
Homological simple connectivity is equivalent to the existence of global harmonic conjugates
A homologically simply connected plane domain is conformally the plane or the disc
A plane domain homeomorphic to the plane or the disc is contractible
Given the cited Riemann mapping theorem, the new bridge implications in the grand equivalence are choice-free
